clauses.text: FitResult carries oof_pred, if_pred_per_fold, metrics, models, history, feature_names, dtypes, categorical_features, splits, data_fingerprint, pipeline_state, calibrator, run_meta.

clauses.note: §7.1 (BLUEPRINT:497-526) enumerates every one of these fields as bullets.

clauses.text: FitResult / PredictionResult / SplitIndices / RunMeta are dataclasses.
clauses.note: Implementation form not observable as contract (capsule example).

clauses.text: oof_pred is an np.ndarray.
clauses.blueprint_quote: `oof_pred`（`np.ndarray / pd.Series`）
clauses.note: BLUEPRINT admits pd.Series (wider type); the field is npt.NDArray[np.float64].

clauses.text: oof_pred shape is (n_samples,) for regression/binary and (n_samples, n_classes) for multiclass.
clauses.note: §7.1 gives no shape for oof_pred.
clauses.prior_text: oof_pred has shape (n_samples,) for regression/binary and (n_samples,n_classes) for multiclass.

clauses.text: if_pred_per_fold has length n_splits and each element predicts the complete training fold.
clauses.note: §7.1 states only the type list[np.ndarray]; §13.4 says IS = IF(train_idx) 集約値 but not the per-element/length contract.
prior_text: if_pred_per_fold length equals n_splits and each element predicts the complete training fold.

clauses.text: metrics hierarchy is fixed: raw/oof, raw/if_mean, raw/if_per_fold always exist.
clauses.blueprint_quote: `{"raw": {"oof": {...}, "oof_per_fold": [...], "if_mean": {...}, "if_per_fold": [...], "oof_coverage": 1.0}, "calibrated": {...}}`
clauses.note: Later additions oof_per_fold (H-0045) and oof_coverage (H-0057) are also stated.

clauses.text: raw/if_per_fold has len == n_splits.
clauses.note: §7.1 / §6.3 name if_per_fold but never its length.

clauses.text: metrics['calibrated'] exists only for binary + calibrator and mirrors raw as {oof, if_mean, if_per_fold}.
clauses.note: H-0067 (HISTORY:5037) fixed the calibrated branch to {oof, oof_per_fold} with IF metrics excluded for leakage; BLUEPRINT:1231 states the H-0067 form.

clauses.text: models is a per-fold list of trained models wrapping EstimatorAdapter.
clauses.blueprint_quote: fold ごとのモデル
clauses.note: Element type (EstimatorAdapter wrapper) is not named; per-fold list meaning is.
clauses.prior_text: models is list[Any], with each model containing an EstimatorAdapter.

clauses.text: history is a per-fold list of dicts carrying eval_history and best_iteration (int).
clauses.blueprint_quote: fold ごとの eval history / best_iteration
clauses.prior_text: history is list[dict] and best_iteration is int.

clauses.text: feature_names is the ordered list[str] of features used in training; dtypes maps feature name -> dtype string; categorical_features lists categorical feature names.
clauses.note: §7.1 line 509 names the three fields only; order fixation and value types are not stated.
prior_text: feature_names is an ordered list[str] of training-used features.
dtypes is dict[str,str] mapping feature names to dtype strings.
categorical_features is list[str] of categorical feature names.

clauses.text: splits is a SplitIndices holding outer / inner / calibration index records.
clauses.blueprint_quote: 外側 CV indices（必須、元データ基準の absolute index）
clauses.note: Content stated in §7.1:510-514; type name SplitIndices appears only in the §19 tree (BLUEPRINT:1741).

clauses.text: data_fingerprint is a DataFingerprint (row_count / column_hash / file_hash).
clauses.blueprint_quote: `row_count / column_hash / optional: file_hash` 等

clauses.text: pipeline_state holds the FeaturePipeline state.
clauses.blueprint_quote: `pipeline_state`（`FeaturePipeline` の状態、必須）

clauses.text: calibrator is present only for binary + calibration enabled (else None).
clauses.blueprint_quote: `calibrator`（有効時）

clauses.text: SplitIndices.outer is a per-fold list of (train_idx, valid_idx) tuples.
clauses.blueprint_quote: 外側 CV: fold ごとの `train_idx / valid_idx`

clauses.text: SplitIndices.inner is per-fold inner-valid indices or None when unused.
clauses.blueprint_quote: inner valid indices（有効時必須。各 outer fold train に対する 0-based 相対 index）

clauses.text: SplitIndices.calibration is calibration CV indices or None when unused.
clauses.blueprint_quote: calibration CV indices（有効時必須）

Convention question: BLUEPRINT uses yourlib as a doc-wide placeholder (§16.1 YourLibError), so the fix is a rename-everywhere decision, not one stale identifier.

clauses.text: RunMeta.run_id is a UUID string and RunMeta.timestamp an ISO-8601 string.
clauses.note: §7.1 run_meta bullet omits run_id and timestamp; §17 mentions run_id generation only for logging.

clauses.text: BaseMetric.needs_simplex is a concrete property defaulting to False; AUC and LogLoss override True; AUCPR / Brier keep False (raw per-class values).

clauses.text: smape is a regression metric: mean(2|y-ŷ|/(|y|+|ŷ|))*100, range [0,200], rows with y=ŷ=0 contribute 0.
clauses.note: Issue #271 MISSING entry, still open: 0 full-token hits for smape in BLUEPRINT; §19 BLUEPRINT:1800 lists 'RMSE, MAE, R2, RMSLE, MAPE, Huber' only.

clauses.text: wape is a regression metric: sum|y-ŷ|/sum|y|*100; raises UNSUPPORTED_METRIC only when sum(|y_true|)==0.
Both have greater_is_better=False and needs_proba=False.
_TASK_METRICS['regression'] includes smape and wape.
smape / wape are feval metrics for regression, so params.metric=smape|wape drives early stopping / learning curves.
